notes.title: Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone!

Rage of the Dragons NEO now has a release date! Get ready to throw down, because intense battles begin on November 14th 🐉

Thank you to everyone who joined the Closed Beta and shared your feedback during Steam Next Fest. Soon, we’ll have even more adventures to experience together!

Don’t miss out on the trailer:

See you soon! 😉
